claim_limitations: Exploratory owner-only, uniformly selected query templates with replacement writes
One schedule per configuration; fixed WAC then ACP order; no independent paired inference
Offered pilot rate is not population-derived service demand or independently established saturation
Latency percentiles of successful replies exclude failures; all-offered deadline fractions retain them
No original media binaries; corpus is partially calibrated, not all service data
No policy-update or minimum-cgroup-memory claim from unexercised operations or absent counters

footprint.scope: remote persisted pack manifest; pre-load du excludes later journal state; process snapshots do not establish the server cgroup RAM minimum

configurations.label: pilot-entropy-8-acp

pod_admission.scope: size comparison only; does not classify a timed-out or generic transport failure as a server rejection

requests.content_write_scope: existing-value replacement; neither net-new ingestion nor expiry was exercised

mutation_commit_evidence.scope: a failed client receipt does not prove the server rolled back or never committed the write

requests.throughput_scope: observed completions over elapsed time including drain, not sustainable goodput or a saturation limit
requests.timeout_classification: generic transport-error rows do not identify the underlying cause; duration is not a timeout classification

verification.authentication: trusted-session deterministic check; HTTP authentication checked separately
verification.oracle: policy-neutral physically filtered content; same SPARQ query evaluator; exact bags or ordered rows plus independent counts

configurations.verification_scope: pack/index checksum validation and sampled policy-neutral reference queries; not all canonical admission gates

runner_scope.content_writes: replace one existing record value; no added records
runner_scope.latency: complete local HTTP response-body latency for conservative local SLO; server header diagnostic only
runner_scope.memory: source-byte cache limit, with outer study cgroup; not minimum server RAM tier
runner_scope.policy_administration: shared manifest-owner authorization for WAC and ACP; not ACP ACR-edit authorization
runner_scope.query_templates: uniform across population templates, not journey-weighted
